chapter_seo_title: Witnessing the End: Desolate Era Chapter 490 - Ji Ning's Parents' Final Moments
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning witnesses the brutal massacre of his past-life parents at the hands of the Seamless Gate, crystallizing a hatred that surpasses all others.
og_description: Ji Ning watches time reverse to reveal the tragic death of Liu Hechuan and Dongliu Xue at the Nine Curves Sword Sect.
twitter_description: Ji Ning's past-life parents are slaughtered by the Seamless Gate. A new, all-consuming hatred is born.

lore_anchors.definition: The metaphysical repository of all events and existences; even after complete annihiliation, a being's core truesoul returns here.
The Chinese mythological underworld; a place souls pass through on their way to reincarnation.
A vast, malevolent organization spanning the Three Realms, responsible for countless massacres to harvest souls for evil techniques.
A former immortal sect that was annihilated by the Seamless Gate to serve as a warning to the rest of the commandery.
A lecherous and cruel Primal Daoist of the Huashan Immortal Sect, indirectly responsible for the tragedy of Liu Hechuan and Dongliu Xue

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Seamless Gate destroy the Nine Curves Sword Sect?
cultural_notes_faq.a: To conquer the commandery without having enough local allies, they chose a few sects to destroy as a terrifying example, harvesting the souls of the dead for evil techniques.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the River of Fate?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The metaphysical repository of all existence where even the most fundamental 'truesoul' of a destroyed being returns to. Recovering a soul from it is considered supremely difficult.
